import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line;
        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null && !line.trim().isEmpty()) {
            int n = Integer.parseInt(line.trim());
            process(n, br);
        }
    }

    static void process(int n, BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        String kLine = br.readLine();
        int k = Integer.parseInt(kLine.trim());

        double[] probabilities = new double[n];
        String[] probStrs = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            probabilities[i] = Double.parseDouble(probStrs[i]);
        }

        double[][] dp = new double[2][1 << n];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], 0.0);
        }

        boolean[] isValid = new boolean[n];
        List<Integer> validIndices = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (probabilities[i] != 0) {
                isValid[i] = true;
                validIndices.add(i);
            }
        }

        int current = 0;
        dp[current][0] = 1.0;

        double[] prefixSum = new double[1 << n];
        prefixSum[0] = 1.0;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            int bitPos = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);
            prefixSum[mask] = prefixSum[mask ^ (1 << bitPos)] - probabilities[bitPos];
        }

        int minCount = Math.min(validIndices.size(), k);
        for (int i = 0; i < minCount; i++) {
            int next = 1 - current;
            Arrays.fill(dp[next], 0.0);
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) != i)
                    continue;
                for (int nextIdx : validIndices) {
                    if (((mask >> nextIdx) & 1) == 0) {
                        dp[next][mask ^ (1 << nextIdx)] += dp[current][mask] * probabilities[nextIdx] / prefixSum[mask];
                    }
                }
            }
            current = 1 - current;
        }

        int finalState = current;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!isValid[i]) {
                System.out.printf("%.12f ", 0.0);
            } else {
                double answer = 0.0;
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                    if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                        answer += dp[finalState][mask];
                    }
                }
                System.out.printf("%.12f ", answer);
            }
        }
        System.out.println();
    }
}
